caption: The drawing shows a symmetrical composition on a textured beige background. At the top is a stylized cross with a red outline and yellow interior, accented with blue shapes and small yellow rays emanating from its base. Below the cross is a bow-like structure with four loops, each loop outlined in blue with a central red area dotted with yellow, converging at a central blue circle with a small inner red circle. Extending horizontally from behind the bow on each side are two rounded shapes resembling wings or leaves; they are filled with yellow and tipped with red. At the bottom center of the drawing, there is a large circular pattern, bordered in red with an inner blue ring. The interior of the circle contains a radial geometric design in red, yellow, and blue, featuring pointed and teardrop shapes arranged symmetrically around a central blue circle.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
